# Alert
Atlas Alert v1 — banner with leading icon, title, description, optional dismiss. 5 intents (info, success, warning, danger, neutral) × 3 sizes (15 total) × boolean Dismissible property (shows a trailing close icon when true, default false).

USE WHEN
· Form-level errors, an explanation above a step, or a persistent notice in the page flow.

DON'T USE WHEN
· A short transient confirmation → Toast.
· A blocking decision → Dialog or AlertDialog.
· A single field is invalid → attach the message to the field.

DO
· Give it at least a title or a description.
· Put recovery actions inside the Alert as Buttons.
· Use danger only for something that failed or will fail.

DON'T
· Make it dismissible while the condition it describes is still true.
· Add an Alert for every field error.

PROPERTIES
Variant: info | success | warning | danger | neutral. Size: sm | md | lg. Dismissible: boolean.
